get_ffmpeg_filters: get the list of available FFmpeg filter names from the spdl library
get_ffmpeg_log_level: get the current FFmpeg log level as an integer value
set_ffmpeg_log_level: set the FFmpeg log level to a specified integer value for verbosity control
get_ffmpeg_versions: get a dictionary mapping FFmpeg library names to their version tuples
review_ffmpeg_utils: review the spdl FFmpeg utility functions for log level and version inspection
